Clean and standardize email strings

Source: R/anon_hash.R
anon_clean_email.Rd

Prepares email addresses for hashing by trimming whitespace, normalizing case, and correcting common typos (e.g. .co endings, .con endings, @gogle domains). Empty strings and NA values are preserved as NA_character_ to prevent hashing the literal string "NA".

Usage

anon_clean_email(x)

Arguments

x

A character vector of email addresses.

Value

A character vector of the same length as x, standardized and ready for hashing.

Examples

emails <- c("alice@uni.edu", "BOB@gmail.co ", NA)
anon_clean_email(emails)
#> [1] "alice@uni.edu" "bob@gmail.com" NA
